newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso seesaws, ends soft.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso seesaws, ends soft.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso closed 1.1 centavos weaker on Monday at 7.5210/7.5260, after seesawing at thin volume, traders said.
"The market has been very quiet, with the peso going in no fixed direction, but staying close to Friday's levels," a trader said.
Traders said the same-day peso opened one centavo down to line up with the benchmark 48-hour peso, and moved little from then until the close.
"There have been no economic data or news items released to move the peso one way or the other," the trader added.
The 48-hour and 24-hour peso meanwhile were both 0.1 of a centavo firmer at 7.5290/7.5310 and 7.5240/7.5270, respectively, per dollar.
Traders said that the peso could weaken if Cetes rates fall at Tuesday's primary auction.
"Cetes (rates) may fall again this week, although there is not much room left for them to do so," a trader said.
